** **
 Harkesh Manuja, J. (Oral)
1. Short prayer made in the present writ petition filed under Article 227 of Constitution of India is for issuance of directions to the Reference Court-cum-Addl. District Judge, Patiala so as to expedite the LAC-35-2017 titled as 'Karnail Singh Vs. Karamjit Singh and Others' invoking Section 3(H)(4) of the National Highways Act, 1956.
opennyai_summary.decision:
Considering the fact that the acquisition in the present case relates to the year 2016 and the matter regarding apportionment is pending since 2017, resultantly, landowners have not been able to receive the compensation amount, the Reference Court i.e. Additional District Judge, Patiala is requested to dispose of abovementioned reference i.e. LAC-35-2017 pending for 27.07.2023 in an expeditious manner preferably within a period of nine months from today.
8. Disposed of in the aforesaid terms.
